subject: GaterNet kickoff — input-conditional compute
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kickoff for the GaterNet workstream. The idea from our CVPR release: a separate gater network looks at the input and selects which filters in the backbone CNN fire — dynamic, input-conditional filter selection, hence you look twice. We have released checkpoints for ResNet-20-Gated and ResNet-56-Gated on CIFAR-10 to build from.

Product angle for vision: input-conditional compute for our edge inference tier, where a static model burns the same FLOPs on easy and hard inputs alike.

Milestones: reproduce the released CIFAR-10 evals by Mar 20, gating study on an internal workload by Apr 30, scale decision in early June.

Rafael, Vera, Rosa and Umar assigned. Over to you.

Lucia
